info.name: HBDRP INTEGRATION
info.description:
HBDRP Integration API

Postman collection for all HBDRP Integration API endpoints — birth & death registration, authentication, status lookups, and real-time callback events for third-party systems.

Base URL

Scope Base URL
Integration APIs https://bdrbeta.npontu.com/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/

How the Registration Flow Works

When a third-party system submits a birth or death record, a unique document number is always generated and returned immediately in the API response — regardless of the record's status. This document number is the record's identifier and is used to track its current state throughout the flow.

From there, the record moves through review → verification → registration → approval & numbering → certification before it is final. At every stage change after submission:

  • A callback event is sent to your configured callback_url
  • The current status can always be pulled via the status lookup endpoint

Steps 2 through 6 each fire a callback event. Step 1 (Submitted) fires no callback — the document number is returned directly in the API response.

There are exactly six callback events, and no others: MARKED_COMPLETE, VERIFIED, DUPLICATE_REJECTED, PUSHED_TO_REGISTRATION, COMPLETED, CERTIFIED.

The Flow at a Glance

Submitted
   |
   ▼
Officer Review .......... (MARKED_COMPLETE)
   |
   ▼
Duplicate Verification .. (VERIFIED ✔ / DUPLICATE_REJECTED ✗)
   |
   ▼
Pushed to Registration .. (PUSHED_TO_REGISTRATION)
   |
   ▼
Approval & Numbering .... (COMPLETED)
   |
   ▼
Certification ........... (CERTIFIED ★ terminal success)
Stage Callback Event Meaning
1. Submitted — none — Record received, document number generated and returned in the API response
2. Officer Review MARKED_COMPLETE Officer reviewed the record and moved it to verification
3. Duplicate Verification VERIFIED / DUPLICATE_REJECTED Checked against existing records
4. Pushed to Registration PUSHED_TO_REGISTRATION Moved into the main registration pipeline
5. Approval & Numbering COMPLETED All approval levels passed; registration number (UBNC) generated
6. Certification CERTIFIED Certificate issued — terminal, successful end state

⚠️ DUPLICATE_REJECTED ends the flow — the record does not continue to registration.

COMPLETED vs CERTIFIED — Important

  • COMPLETED means the record has passed all approval levels and the registration number / UBNC has been generated. It does not mean a certificate has been issued. At this point the certification record exists but is still pending.
  • CERTIFIED is the terminal success event. It fires later, when the certifying officer formally issues the certificate. Integrators expecting a final "certificate issued" signal must listen for CERTIFIED, not COMPLETED.
  • Both COMPLETED and CERTIFIED carry registration_no, ubnc and certificate_number — these three fields always hold the same value.
  • APPROVED is not a callback event and is never sent to your callback_url. It appears only as a polling stage returned by the status lookup endpoint. Use the COMPLETED callback to be notified of this stage.

Status can always be checked directly via:

  • GET /integrations/registrations/birth/{documentNumber}
  • GET /integrations/registrations/death/{documentNumber}

Callback Delivery Behaviour

  • Callbacks are POSTed to the institution's configured callback_url.
  • Headers sent with each callback: Content-Type, Accept, X-Event-Type, X-Document-Number, X-Timestamp.
  • Failed deliveries retry with exponential backoff: 1 min, 5 min, 15 min, 30 min, 60 min (5 attempts total). Respond with any 2xx status to acknowledge.

📁 See the "Callback Events Documentation" folder (under BETA) for the full flow reference — including the complete event table, callback delivery requirements, and a step-by-step breakdown of each stage.

Getting Started

1. Environment Setup

Create a new environment in Postman and add the following variables:

Variable Description Example
base_url Your API base URL https://bdrbeta.npontu.com
token Your API authentication token (for Integration APIs) —
selected_affiliation Your selected affiliation REGISTRY · DISTRICT · REGION · NATIONAL

2. Authentication

Integration APIs (Third-Party)

Method How it works
Legacy Send a long-lived api_token in the Token or Authorization: Bearer header on every request.
Preferred Call POST /integrations/auth/token with api_token → receive an access_token (60 min TTL) and a refresh_token. Send Authorization: Bearer on each request. Before 60 min, call POST /integrations/auth/refresh with the refresh_token in the body to get new tokens.

Middleware: apiConsumer — automatically injects user_id and source_institution_code.

3. Headers Configuration

All requests require:

Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
Token: your-token-here
# — or —
Authorization: Bearer your-token-here

For Integration APIs, use the access_token when using the token-refresh flow.

Request Guidelines

Request Body

  • All request bodies must be in JSON format.
  • For fields requiring specific values, use the Utility endpoint to fetch valid options.
  • Required fields are marked with comments.

Common Utility Types

REGION · DISTRICT · REGISTRY · TOWN · NATIONAL_ID · GENDER · MARITAL_STATUS · EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL · RELIGION · NATIONALITY · INFORMANT_TYPE · BIRTH_TYPE · BIRTH_ATTENDANT · PLACE_OF_BIRTH

Rate Limiting

API Type Policy
Integration APIs Per-consumer rate limiting (configurable per ApiConsumer)
Admin APIs Standard rate limiting

Collection Structure

Folder Contents

Birth Registrations Create / Update / Get Birth Record
Death Registrations Create / Get Death Record
Callback Events Documentation Full flow reference & event payload examples

Support

For additional support, please contact our support team.

item.name: Auth (Token & Refresh)

request.description:
Get Access Token

POST https://bdrbeta.npontu.com/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/auth/token

Exchanges your long-lived API-consumer token for a short-lived access token (and a refresh token). Send your API token in the Token header (or Authorization: Bearer <api_token>). The request body is empty ({}).

Auth

Header Required Notes
Token Required Your long-lived API-consumer token.

Response

Returns an access_token and a refresh_token.

  • access_token expires in 60 minutes — use it as the Token on registration/utility requests.
  • refresh_token — pass to the Refresh Token request to get a new pair without re-sending your long-lived token.

Tip: save access_token and refresh_token to your environment after this call so downstream requests pick them up automatically.

Refresh Token

POST https://bdrbeta.npontu.com/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/auth/refresh

Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access_token / refresh_token pair, so you can keep calling the API after the 60-minute access token expires — without re-sending your long-lived API-consumer token.

Request body

Field Required Type Notes
refresh_token Required string The refresh_token returned by Get Access Token (or the previous refresh). 
{ "refresh_token": "{{refresh_token}}" }

Auth

No additional auth header is required — the refresh_token in the body is the credential.

Response

Returns a new access_token (valid 60 minutes) and a new refresh_token. Save both to your environment; the previous refresh token should be considered rotated/invalid after use.

item.description:
Authentication (Token & Refresh)

Overview

Every third-party integration call is authenticated with a short-lived access token. You start from a long-lived API-consumer token (issued to you during setup) and exchange it for an access/refresh token pair. This folder contains the two endpoints that manage that lifecycle.

The token lifecycle

Step Call You send You get back
1 Get Access Token Long-lived API token (in Token / Authorization: Bearer header) access_token (valid 60 min) + refresh_token
2 Use the API access_token as the Token header on registration/utility calls Normal API responses
3 Refresh Token (before the 60 min elapses) refresh_token in the body A new access_token + refresh_token pair

Recommended flow

  1. Call Get Access Token once with your long-lived API token. Store the returned access_token and refresh_token (e.g. in your Postman environment).
  2. Send access_token as the Token header on all registration, utility, and record-lookup requests.
  3. Before the access token's 60-minute window expires, call Refresh Token with the stored refresh_token to rotate to a fresh pair — without re-sending your long-lived token.
  4. Persist the new tokens each time; a used refresh_token should be treated as rotated/invalid.

Notes

  • Keep the long-lived API token secret — it is only used against Get Access Token, never on data endpoints.
  • If a request returns an auth error, refresh the token (or re-run Get Access Token) and retry.

Requests in this folder

Request Method & Path Purpose
Get Access Token POST .../integrations/auth/token Exchange long-lived token for an access/refresh pair.
Refresh Token POST .../integrations/auth/refresh Rotate an expiring access token using the refresh token.

item.name: Birth Registrations

request.description:
Get Birth Record (Status Lookup)

GET /integrations/registrations/birth/{documentNumber}

Returns the current state and callback history of a birth record. Use this to poll a record's progress at any time.

process_flow.current_stage

The process_flow.current_stage field returns one of:

SUBMITTED, DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW, MARKED_COMPLETE, IN_VERIFICATION, VERIFIED, DUPLICATE_REJECTED, IN_REGISTRATION, APPROVED, CERTIFIED

APPROVED appears here as a polling stage only — it is never delivered as a webhook. Use the COMPLETED callback to be notified of this stage.

Certification status

process_flow.stages.certification.is_certified is false while the record is approved but not yet certified, and becomes true once the certificate has been issued.

callback_history

The callback_history array lists every callback event that has been dispatched for the record, each with its event_type, callback_status and timestamp.

request.description:
Create Birth Record

POST https://bdrbeta.npontu.com/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/registrations/birth

Creates a new birth registration record for third-party integrations. Authenticate with your API-consumer Token header.

  • status = DRAFT — saved as-is (return status PENDING); only status, region_id, district_id are enforced. Editable later via the update endpoint.
  • status = COMPLETE — every Required field below is validated before the record moves to verification, approval & certification.
  • Early vs Late birth is auto-determined from child_dob (under 1 year → Early Birth; 1 year or older → Late Birth). Do not send it.

Field status below matches the third-party field reference exactly (COMPLETE validation).

Top-level

Field Req/Cond/Opt Type / Constraints Notes
status Required DRAFT | COMPLETE
region_id Required numeric ID (REGION) Region of registration
district_id Required numeric ID (DISTRICT) Must belong to region_id
type_of_birth Required coded (BIRTH_TYPE) e.g. SINGLETON

System-set fields — do NOT send

These are taken from your token or assigned automatically; sending them has no effect:

  • created_by
  • third_party_user_id
  • registry_id (auto-assigned round-robin among active registries in the submitted district)
  • document_number (generated on create; passed back in the URL to update)

Coded (lookup) values

Fields marked coded accept only values that exist in the system's reference tables and are case/spelling sensitive. Fetch the allowed values from the utilities endpoint before submitting (by utility_type): REGION, DISTRICT, TOWN, GENDER, INFORMANT_TYPE, NATIONAL_ID, PLACE_OF_BIRTH, BIRTH_ATTENDANT, MARITAL_STATUS, EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL, RELIGION, NATIONALITY, BIRTH_TYPE.

  • region_id / district_id are numeric IDs; the district must belong to the region.
  • Coded name fields (gender, marital status, etc.) are exact names, e.g. "MALE", "MARRIED".

{
  "status": "DRAFT",
  "region_id": 1,
  "district_id": 1
}

request.description:
Update Birth Record

POST https://bdrbeta.npontu.com/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/registrations/birth/{{documentNumber}}

Updates an existing birth registration record identified by documentNumber in the URL. Authenticate with your API-consumer Token header. The body uses the same fields and validation rules as Create Birth Record; you re-submit the full record for the document you are updating.

  • status = DRAFT — saved as-is (return status PENDING); only status, region_id, district_id are enforced. A DRAFT can be updated repeatedly while you gather data.
  • status = COMPLETE — every Required field below is validated before the record moves to verification, approval & certification. Typical flow: submit DRAFT first, then re-submit the same documentNumber with COMPLETE once everything is filled in.
  • Early vs Late birth is auto-determined from child_dob (under 1 year → Early Birth; 1 year or older → Late Birth). Do not send it.
  • documentNumber is passed in the URL path (not the body) to identify the record.

Field status below matches the third-party field reference exactly (COMPLETE validation).

Informant

Field Req/Cond/Opt Type / Constraints Notes
informant_type Required coded (INFORMANT_TYPE) e.g. MOTHER
informant_national_id_type Required coded (NATIONAL_ID) e.g. GHANA CARD
informant_national_id_number Required alphanumeric + hyphen, max 20
informant_first_name Required string
informant_last_name Required string
informant_residential_address Required string, max 300
informant_phone_number Required ^(\+)?[0-9]{10,}$
informant_middle_name Optional string
informant_region_id Optional numeric ID (REGION) If sent with district, district must match region
informant_district_id Optional numeric ID (DISTRICT)
informant_town Optional string

Child

Field Req/Cond/Opt Type / Constraints Notes
child_first_name Required string Blacklist-checked
child_last_name Required string Blacklist-checked
child_gender Required coded (GENDER) e.g. MALE
child_dob Required date YYYY-MM-DD, not future Determines Early/Late birth
child_place_of_birth Required coded (PLACE_OF_BIRTH) e.g. HOSPITAL
child_birth_attendant Required coded (BIRTH_ATTENDANT) e.g. MID-WIFE
child_birth_institution Required string, max 500
child_town Required coded (TOWN)
child_middle_name Optional string
child_national_id_type Optional coded (NATIONAL_ID)
child_national_id_number Optional alphanumeric + hyphen, max 20
child_house_no Optional string
child_street_name Optional string

Mother

Required unless doubtful_maternity=1. If the mother is non-Ghanaian, her national-ID fields also become required.

Field Req/Cond/Opt Type / Constraints Notes
mother_nationality Conditional coded (NATIONALITY) Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_first_name Conditional string Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_last_name Conditional string Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_age Conditional integer 11–70 Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_phone_number Conditional ^(\+)?[0-9]{10,}$ Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_marital_status Conditional coded (MARITAL_STATUS) Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_previous_birth_no Conditional integer, max 50 Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_occupation Conditional string Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_educational_level Conditional coded (EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL) Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_residence Conditional string Required unless doubtful_maternity=1
mother_national_id_type Conditional coded (NATIONAL_ID) Required if mother is non-Ghanaian
mother_national_id_number Conditional alphanumeric + hyphen, max 20 Required if mother is non-Ghanaian
mother_nationality_issued_date Conditional date YYYY-MM-DD Required if non-Ghanaian; must be before child_dob
mother_middle_name Optional string
mother_religion Optional coded (RELIGION)
mother_region_id Optional numeric ID (REGION)
mother_district_id Optional numeric ID (DISTRICT)
mother_town Optional coded (TOWN)
doubtful_maternity Optional 0 / 1 Set 1 to skip mother requirements

Father

Same pattern as mother, keyed on doubtful_paternity and the father's nationality.

Field Req/Cond/Opt Type / Constraints Notes
father_nationality Conditional coded (NATIONALITY) Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_first_name Conditional string Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_last_name Conditional string Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_age Conditional integer 11–80 Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_phone_number Conditional ^(\+)?[0-9]{10,}$ Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_marital_status Conditional coded (MARITAL_STATUS) Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_children_no Conditional integer, max 50 Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_occupation Conditional string Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_religion Conditional coded (RELIGION) Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_educational_level Conditional coded (EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL) Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_residence Conditional string Required unless doubtful_paternity=1
father_national_id_type Conditional coded (NATIONAL_ID) Required if father is non-Ghanaian
father_national_id_number Conditional alphanumeric + hyphen, max 20 Required if father is non-Ghanaian
father_nationality_issued_date Conditional date YYYY-MM-DD Required if non-Ghanaian; must be before child_dob
father_middle_name Optional string
father_region_id Optional numeric ID (REGION)
father_district_id Optional numeric ID (DISTRICT)
father_town Optional coded (TOWN)
doubtful_paternity Optional 0 / 1 Set 1 to skip father requirements

Evidence

Field Req/Cond/Opt Type / Constraints Notes
child_file_birth_evidence_name Optional array of strings File names
child_file_birth_evidence_data Optional array of base64 data: URLs PDF / JPG / PNG (parallel to the name array)

Top-level

Field Req/Cond/Opt Type / Constraints Notes
status Required DRAFT | COMPLETE
region_id Required numeric ID (REGION) Region of registration
district_id Required numeric ID (DISTRICT) Must belong to region_id
type_of_birth Required coded (BIRTH_TYPE) e.g. SINGLETON

System-set fields — do NOT send

These are taken from your token or assigned automatically; sending them has no effect:

  • created_by
  • third_party_user_id
  • registry_id (auto-assigned round-robin among active registries in the submitted district)
  • document_number (identifies the record; passed in the URL path, not the body)

Coded (lookup) values

Fields marked coded accept only values that exist in the system's reference tables and are case/spelling sensitive. Fetch the allowed values from the utilities endpoint before submitting (by utility_type): REGION, DISTRICT, TOWN, GENDER, INFORMANT_TYPE, NATIONAL_ID, PLACE_OF_BIRTH, BIRTH_ATTENDANT, MARITAL_STATUS, EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL, RELIGION, NATIONALITY, BIRTH_TYPE.

  • region_id / district_id are numeric IDs; the district must belong to the region.
  • Coded name fields (gender, marital status, etc.) are exact names, e.g. "MALE", "MARRIED".

Minimal DRAFT example

Send to .../registrations/birth/{{documentNumber}}:

{
  "status": "DRAFT",
  "region_id": 1,
  "district_id": 1
}

item.description:
Birth Registrations

Endpoints for submitting, updating and looking up birth records.

  • Create Birth Record — submits a new birth record. A unique document number is generated and returned directly in the API response (no callback is fired at submission).
  • Update Birth Record — updates a record that is still in DRAFT/editable state.
  • Get Birth Record — status lookup. Returns the current process_flow.current_stage and the callback_history for the record.

After submission the record moves through review → verification → registration → approval & numbering → certification. Steps 2–6 each fire a callback event (MARKED_COMPLETE, VERIFIED or DUPLICATE_REJECTED, PUSHED_TO_REGISTRATION, COMPLETED, CERTIFIED) to your configured callback_url. See the Callback Events Documentation folder for full details.

item.name: Death Registrations

request.description:
Get Death Record (Status Lookup)

GET /integrations/registrations/death/{documentNumber}

Returns the current state and callback history of a death record. Use this to poll a record's progress at any time.

process_flow.current_stage

The process_flow.current_stage field returns one of:

SUBMITTED, DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW, MARKED_COMPLETE, IN_VERIFICATION, VERIFIED, DUPLICATE_REJECTED, IN_REGISTRATION, APPROVED, CERTIFIED

APPROVED appears here as a polling stage only — it is never delivered as a webhook. Use the COMPLETED callback to be notified of this stage.

Certification status

process_flow.stages.certification.is_certified is false while the record is approved but not yet certified, and becomes true once the certificate has been issued.

callback_history

The callback_history array lists every callback event that has been dispatched for the record, each with its event_type, callback_status and timestamp.

item.description:
Death Registrations

Endpoints for submitting and looking up death records.

  • Create Death Record — submits a new death record. A unique document number is generated and returned directly in the API response (no callback is fired at submission).
  • Get Death Record — status lookup. Returns the current process_flow.current_stage and the callback_history for the record.

After submission the record moves through review → verification → registration → approval & numbering → certification. Steps 2–6 each fire a callback event (MARKED_COMPLETE, VERIFIED or DUPLICATE_REJECTED, PUSHED_TO_REGISTRATION, COMPLETED, CERTIFIED) to your configured callback_url. See the Callback Events Documentation folder for full details..

request.description:
Event Types Summary

Use the Get Birth Record or Get Death Record endpoint to check the current status and callback history of a record.

The Six Callback Events

These are the only event types delivered to your callback_url:

Callback Event Status Description
MARKED_COMPLETE IN_VERIFICATION Officer marked record complete, moved to verification
VERIFIED VERIFIED Passed duplicate verification
DUPLICATE_REJECTED REJECTED Record failed duplicate check — flow ends
PUSHED_TO_REGISTRATION IN_PROGRESS Moved to main registration table
COMPLETED APPROVED All approval levels passed; registration number (UBNC) generated
CERTIFIED CERTIFIED Certificate issued (terminal success)

⚠️ APPROVED is not a callback event and is never delivered to your callback_url. It appears only as a polling stage (see below). Use the COMPLETED callback to be notified when a record reaches this stage.

COMPLETED vs CERTIFIED

  • COMPLETED = all approvals passed and the registration number / UBNC has been generated. The certificate has not yet been issued.
  • CERTIFIED = the certificate has been formally issued (terminal success).
  • Both carry registration_no, ubnc and certificate_number, which always hold the same value.

Process Flow Stages

The process_flow object in the response shows:

{
  "process_flow": {
    "current_stage": "IN_VERIFICATION",
    "stages": {
      "integration": { },
      "verification": { },
      "registration": { },
      "certification": { "is_certified": false }
    }
  },
  "callback_history": [
    {
      "event_type": "MARKED_COMPLETE",
      "callback_status": "SUCCESS",
      "timestamp": "2026-01-27T16:48:43+00:00"
    }
  ]
}

process_flow.stages.certification.is_certified is false while the record is approved but not yet certified, and becomes true once the certificate has been issued.

Current Stage Values (Polling)

process_flow.current_stage returns one of:

Stage Description
SUBMITTED Record submitted
DRAFT Third-party still editing
PENDING_REVIEW Awaiting officer review
MARKED_COMPLETE Officer marked complete
IN_VERIFICATION Being verified for duplicates
VERIFIED Passed verification
DUPLICATE_REJECTED Failed duplicate check
IN_REGISTRATION In registration workflow
APPROVED All approvals complete (polling stage only — see note below)
CERTIFIED Certificate issued

APPROVED appears here as a polling stage only — it is never delivered as a webhook. Use the COMPLETED callback to be notified of this stage.

item.description:
Callback Events Documentation

This folder documents the real-time callback events the HBDRP platform sends to your configured callback_url as a birth or death record moves through its lifecycle. Each request in this folder is a documentation stub whose body shows a representative payload for that event.

The Six Callback Events

There are exactly six callback events, in flow order:

# Event Fired When
1 MARKED_COMPLETE Officer reviews the record and moves it to verification
2 VERIFIED Record passes duplicate verification
— DUPLICATE_REJECTED Record fails duplicate verification — flow ends
3 PUSHED_TO_REGISTRATION Verified record enters the main registration pipeline
4 COMPLETED All approval levels passed; registration number / UBNC generated
5 CERTIFIED Certifying officer issues the certificate — terminal success

APPROVED is not a callback event and is never delivered to your callback_url. It exists only as a polling stage on the status lookup endpoint. Listen for the COMPLETED callback instead.

COMPLETED vs CERTIFIED

  • COMPLETED = all approvals passed and the registration number / UBNC has been generated. The certificate has not yet been issued; the certification record is still pending.
  • CERTIFIED = the certificate has been formally issued. This is the terminal "certificate issued" signal integrators should wait for.
  • Both events carry registration_no, ubnc and certificate_number, which always hold the same value.

Delivery Behaviour

  • Callbacks are POSTed to your configured callback_url.
  • Headers sent with each callback: Content-Type, Accept, X-Event-Type, X-Document-Number, X-Timestamp.
  • Failed deliveries retry with exponential backoff: 1 min, 5 min, 15 min, 30 min, 60 min (5 attempts total). Respond with any 2xx status to acknowledge.

request.description:
Utilities (coded-value lookup)

POST https://bdrbeta.npontu.com/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/utility

Fetches the allowed coded (lookup) values used across birth and death registration payloads (regions, districts, registries, gender, marital status, etc.). Any field marked coded in the registration docs must exactly match a value returned here (case/spelling sensitive). Authenticate with your API-consumer Token header.

Request body

Field Required Type Notes
utility_type Required enum The lookup list to fetch. One of the values below.
country_id Conditional integer Required when utility_type = REGION.
region_id Conditional integer Required when utility_type = DISTRICT.
district_id Conditional integer Required when utility_type = REGISTRY.

Allowed utility_type values

COUNTRY, REGION, NATIONALITY, DISTRICT, REGISTRY, NATIONAL_ID, TOWN, GENDER, BIRTH_TYPE, BIRTH_ATTENDANT, RELIGION, EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL, INFORMANT_TYPE, MARITAL_STATUS, PLACE_OF_BIRTH.

How the hierarchy works

Location lookups cascade — fetch each level using the ID from the level above:

  1. COUNTRY → gives country_id
  2. REGION (needs country_id) → gives region_id
  3. DISTRICT (needs region_id) → gives district_id
  4. REGISTRY (needs district_id)

Use the returned numeric IDs for region_id / district_id in registration payloads, and the returned exact names for coded name fields (e.g. gender "MALE", marital status "MARRIED").
